name: Aquitect's Will — the target with a flood counter is an Island, an untargeted land with one is not
notes: Memory: project_aquitects_will_counter_on_target_audit_2026-10-15. 'Put a flood counter on target land. That land is an Island in addition to its other types for as long as it has a flood counter on it.' The site leaves placing the counter to the player. The audit reported target-changes-nothing because no land on its board had a flood counter; it now puts the counter on every listed target first. This locks the site's behaviour: any land can be targeted, the targeted land with a flood counter becomes an Island with {U}, and another land with a flood counter is untouched.
